# QuietReplay

> Records what happens on a Chrome page and saves it on your computer. Press Record. Nothing is sent online, and there is no account. Under the hood it is a local MV3 extension: full session of a tab from Record to Stop (console, network, clicks, screenshots, optional video) in a ZIP, with no network calls.
